WITH year_total AS (
    select c_customer_id customer_id,
           c_first_name customer_first_name,
           c_last_name customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
           c_login customer_login,
           c_email_address customer_email_address,
           d_year dyear,
           sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
           's' sale_type
    from customer, store_sales, date_dim
    where c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
      and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    group by c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    union all
    select c_customer_id customer_id,
           c_first_name customer_first_name,
           c_last_name customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
           c_login customer_login,
           c_email_address customer_email_address,
           d_year dyear,
           sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
           'w' sale_type
    from customer, web_sales, date_dim
    where c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
      and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    group by c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
totals AS (
    SELECT customer_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 's' AND dyear = 1998 THEN total END) AS s_first_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 's' AND dyear = 1998 + 1 THEN total END) AS s_second_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 THEN total END) AS w_first_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 + 1 THEN total END) AS w_second_total
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               d.d_year AS dyear,
               SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total,
               's' AS channel
        FROM store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
        GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, d.d_year
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               d.d_year AS dyear,
               SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total,
               'w' AS channel
        FROM web_sales ws
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
        GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, d.d_year
    ) AS channel_totals
    GROUP BY customer_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
       c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
       c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN totals yt ON c.c_customer_sk = yt.customer_sk
WHERE yt.s_first_total > 0
  AND yt.w_first_total > 0
  AND CASE WHEN yt.w_first_total > 0 THEN yt.w_second_total / yt.w_first_total ELSE 0.0 END
      > CASE WHEN yt.s_first_total > 0 THEN yt.s_second_total / yt.s_first_total ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
